text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock D after large gains felt rewarding, but I should avoid trimming mechanically and instead weigh its prospects and my portfolio allocation.","My purchases of Stocks B and E should be based on their expected value and how they fit my overall portfolio, not simply on recent price movements.","A few periods of volatility and a later rebound reinforce that I should review my plan periodically, but avoid reacting to short-term changes or trading just to stay active."]}
